name: VLUN Technology
summary: VLUN Technology, known in Chinese as Huilun Technology, is a Guangzhou embodied robotics company incubated by GAC Group. Established as an independent operating business in 2026, it took over GAC’s humanoid robotics research and commercialization activities. It develops robot platforms, motion control, perception and core components for security inspection, industrial manufacturing and park services.
